studio.followStructureHelp: Check connections, chronology and notes. The assistant reports what it has read and what remains.

studio.preferencesHelp: A single decision does not become a lasting rule. Inferences need confirmation, and works can have different styles.
studio.noPreferences: No preferences recorded. You can give instructions for a single task instead.
studio.restoreBoundary: Restore changes only this chapter's text and creates a new version. It does not restore titles, notes or other chapters created by a split.
studio.checkpointName: Name this version, for example: rhythm revision complete
studio.restoreConfirm: Restore this version's text in “{title}”? The current version remains in history.

studio.noSummary: No summary yet. Add one when useful.
studio.title: Title
studio.plannedHelp: This chapter is planned, not established manuscript text
studio.confirmStructure: Save and confirm against current text
studio.noProposalsHelp: Discuss the diagnosis first. Choose “Suggest edits” when you want alternative wording.
studio.splitBoundary: This proposal changes chapter structure. Text history restores do not undo an entire split.
studio.proposalStale: The manuscript changed. This proposal uses an older version; check it and request a new proposal.
studio.proposalConflict: The proposal cannot be located precisely in the current text and cannot be adopted yet.
studio.storageDescription: Manuscripts, versions and original uploaded files are saved in the local database and file storage.
studio.sendingDescription: The assistant sends your question, text read within the agreed scope, and allowed sources to the configured model. Uploaded materials are extracted, transcribed or analysed by type and may be sent in full during processing.
studio.providerTerms: Retention and training use depend on the provider's terms. Confirm again when the endpoint changes.
studio.leaveDraftHelp: These edits are not saved as a manuscript version. A browser recovery draft stays on this device if you leave.
studio.notesHelp: Notes guide the work; sources keep their provenance. Pending ideas are not established facts.
studio.noteConfirmed: Confirmed by the author; may be used as task background
studio.uploadHelp: Uploading queues processing and may send the original file to the configured model.
studio.conflictHelp: These sources conflict. Compare their origins; no note automatically overrides the manuscript.
studio.noNotes: No notes here yet. Add them when useful.
studio.scopeHelp: Applies to the selected chapter; cross-chapter tasks show this scope.
studio.continueMismatch: The previous task uses another chapter, mode or older text. Open its source, or start a new task with the current version.
studio.summaryUsed: Chapter summary used; text coverage reported separately
studio.compareSavedDraft: Compare saved text and current edits
studio.replaceLatestConfirm: Have you compared the latest text? Saving replaces it with your current edits and keeps the history.
